title: A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: A million followers can create extraordinary reach while remaining a rented route to people—subject to platform rules, access loss, algorithmic distribution, and incomplete portability.
Construction evidence can outlive the operating house—but only if the physical object and record stay paired.

01 · REACH — What can the platform do exceptionally well?. Discovery, social proof, conversation, cultural participation, and rapid distribution are real institutional advantages. The audit begins by naming that value rather than treating dependency as failure.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · ACCESS — Who can enter and recover the account?. Record the account owner, administrators, authentication method, recovery contacts, device access, and escalation route. A display name or founder face does not prove operational control.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · PORTABILITY — What can leave with consent and context?. Map content originals, captions, contacts, customer records, permissions, analytics exports, and conversation history. Preserve only what may lawfully and ethically be retained.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · ROUTE — How many ways can the institution reach people?. Build at least one controlled destination and one consent-based contact route. Redundancy should improve continuity without manipulating audiences or copying data beyond its stated purpose.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
